import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from pathlib import Path
from surveys.io import read_survey_file

var = "Q35"
df, _ = read_survey_file(Path("/home/hubcad25/opubliq/gdrive/_SharedFolder_data_produit/eeq_2014/Quebec Election Study 2014.sav"), usecols=[var])

if var not in df.columns:
    # usecols a échoué silencieusement — relire sans filtre pour lister les colonnes dispo
    df_all, _ = read_survey_file(Path("/home/hubcad25/opubliq/gdrive/_SharedFolder_data_produit/eeq_2014/Quebec Election Study 2014.sav"))
    print(f"ERROR: '{var}' not found. Available: {list(df_all.columns[:20])}")
    sys.exit(1)

print(f"dtype: {df[var].dtype}")
print(f"missing: {df[var].isna().sum()} / {len(df)}")
print(df[var].value_counts(dropna=False).sort_index().head(25))
EOF
